headline: Belrise Industries Limited: Agreements
sum: Agreements — Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company has approved the acqusition of india tipper body business of Hyva (india) Pvt. Ltd.
detail: Agreements — Belrise Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company has approved the acqusition of india tipper body business of Hyva (india) Pvt. Ltd. vide entering into Business Transfer Agreement ("BTA") at a consideration of USD 5.65 million (approximately INR 543.88 Million)
